name: return
description: Returns a value, expression result, or child nodes to the nearest caller

input.description: Value or expression to return when no child nodes are supplied; one expression match returns its value, multiple matches return cloned nodes

*.description: Child node forwarded to the nearest caller without evaluation; when children exist, all children are returned as-is

output.description: Resolves to the supplied value and/or returned child nodes captured by the nearest caller
